door_rules: Every door is an opening cut through EVERY wall segment lying on its line (wall 'x' = wall at constant X, span is a Y range; wall 'y' = wall at constant Y, span is an X range). Openings are floor level, full width, 'height' tall. 'sealed' doors get a solid maroon block filling the opening. In greybox ALL other doors are left open so the whole level can be walked.
